I don't have a table literally called "admission log," but the closest thing is the **encounters** table, which tracks patient visits (including admissions). Here are its columns:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `encounter_id` | Unique identifier for the encounter |
| `csn` | Contact serial number |
| `patient_id` | Patient the visit belongs to |
| `facility_id` | Facility where the visit occurred |
| `department_id` | Department handling the visit |
| `attending_provider_id` | Attending provider |
| `encounter_type` | Type of encounter (e.g., outpatient, inpatient) |
| `encounter_class` | Class of encounter (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP) |
| `start_datetime` | Start date/time of the visit |
